title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) released iOS 11.4.1 for iPhones and iPads
text:
July 10, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) released iOS 11.4.1 for iPhones and iPads
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) released iOS 11.4.1 for iPhones and iPads, a small update that fixes a couple bugs and introduces a new security feature.
The notes users will see when they go to the Settings app to update their phones are as follows:
iOS 11.4.1 includes bug fixes and improves the security of your iPhone or iPad. This update:
Fixes an issue that prevented some users from viewing the last known location of their AirPods in Find My iPhone, it improves reliability of syncing mail, contacts, and notes with Exchange accounts.
This is the fifteenth update since iOS 11 released last September. It’s available to the same devices as iOS 11.4, the iPhone 5S and later, the iPad Air and later, the iPad mini 2 and later, and 2015 iPod touch.
